claims.claim: Frontmatter description: 'Configure MCP servers in Arena scenarios for integration testing'
Arena connects real MCP servers and verifies tool calls in scenarios
MCP servers are configured by stdio via the 'command' field
MCP servers are configured by static HTTP+SSE via the 'url' field
Stdio and HTTP+SSE servers are long-lived processes shared across all scenarios
Per-scenario/per-session MCP containers are covered by provision-mcp-sandbox
apiVersion promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1
kind Arena
metadata.name is a free-form string (example 'mcp-test')
spec.mcp_servers is a list field on the Arena spec
mcp_servers entry field name
mcp_servers entry field command
mcp_servers entry field args is a list of strings
spec.prompt_configs is a list with id and file fields
spec.scenarios is a list with a file field
spec.providers is a list with a file field
Arena starts the MCP server, discovers its tools and registers them for scenarios
Field tool_filter limits which MCP tools are available
tool_filter.allowlist is a list of tool names
Allowlist example names echo and get-sum
tool_filter.blocklist is a list of tool names
Blocklist example names drop_table and truncate_table
Example runs python mcp_db_server.py
mcp_servers entry field env is a map of environment variables
${VAR} in env values is replaced from the environment promptarena runs in; an unset variable becomes empty
mcp_servers entry field working_dir sets the server process working directory
mcp_servers entry field timeout_ms is in milliseconds
timeout_ms applies per request
MCP tools are named mcp__{serverName}__{toolName}
A prompt reaches only the tools named in allowed_tools; no entry means no tools
Without tool access, the model writes tool-shaped text into content instead of issuing tool calls
If a provider declares a capabilities list, it must include 'tools'
PromptConfig kind with apiVersion promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1
spec.task_type, spec.version and spec.description are PromptConfig fields
spec.allowed_tools is a list of tool names on PromptConfig
Tool name mcp__everything__echo is valid in allowed_tools
Tool name mcp__everything__get-sum is valid in allowed_tools
spec.system_template is a PromptConfig field
Mock responses file has a top-level scenarios map keyed by scenario id
Mock scenario entries have a turns map keyed by turn number
Mock turn field tool_calls is a list with name and arguments
Mock turn field response sets assistant text
Scenario apiVersion promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1 and kind Scenario
spec.id, spec.task_type and spec.description are Scenario fields
spec.tool_policy is a Scenario field
tool_policy.tool_choice accepts value 'auto'
tool_policy.max_tool_calls_per_turn is an integer field
spec.turns is a list of turn objects with role and content
Turn field assertions is a list of assertion objects with type and params
tools_called is a registered assertion type
tools_called params take a tools list
content_includes is a registered assertion type
content_includes params take a patterns list
Second MCP server in the same config accepts the same tool_filter.allowlist form
Filesystem example uses the @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem package with a ./data directory argument
Filesystem example tool names read_file and list_directory
Complete example uses mcp_servers timeout_ms: 10000
Complete example allowlist is [echo, get-sum]
Complete example prompt_configs id mcp-assistant with file prompts/mcp-assistant.yaml
Complete example scenario file scenarios/echo-and-add.scenario.yaml
Complete example provider file providers/mock-provider.yaml
spec.defaults.temperature is a field (value 0.7)
spec.defaults.max_tokens is a field (value 500)
spec.defaults.concurrency is a field (value 1)
spec.defaults.output.dir and output.formats are fields
Output formats json and markdown are accepted
Example directory is examples/mcp-everything-test
Binary promptarena has a run subcommand accepting -c for config
Link target /arena/how-to/agents/provision-mcp-sandbox/ exists
External link https://promptkit.altairalabs.ai/sdk/how-to/configure-mcp/ exists
External link https://promptkit.altairalabs.ai/runtime/how-to/integrate-mcp/ exists
Link target /arena/how-to/agents/test-a2a-agents/ exists
Link target /arena/how-to/scenarios/write-scenarios/ exists
headers values on a url server expand ${VAR} the same way

An mcp_servers entry needs a name and exactly one of command, url or source, and a transport that matches (stdio needs command; sse and streamable_http need url), otherwise the config fails to load in validate and run
